description: Return the stored index passage for a search cite. Pass id from the cite, or source plus doc. Not a live web fetch. If ok is false, the index has no passage.

doc.description: Document id when id is omitted (with source).

id.description: Vectorize id from a search cite.

source.description: Corpus source when id is omitted (with doc).

uri.description: intel:// locator from a cite. Preferred over id when present.

name: get_passage
